translations.web: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”
translations.bsb: “So where is he?” their father asked. “Why did you leave the man behind? Invite him to have something to eat.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
